description: This PHP class defines a data transfer object (DTO) for filtering holiday searches within the OrangeHRM Leave module. It extends from DateRangeSearchFilterParams and adds a boolean property to exclude recurring holidays, along with initialization and getter/setter methods.

classes.name: HolidaySearchFilterParams
classes.description: A DTO for specifying filters when searching for holidays, including date range and whether to exclude recurring holidays.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the object and sets the default sort field to 'holiday.date'.

methods.name: isExcludeRecurring
methods.description: Returns whether the filter is set to exclude recurring holidays.

methods.name: setExcludeRecurring
methods.description: Sets whether to exclude recurring holidays from the search results.
